finish_invitation.speaker: liam
finish_invitation.text: Can we go and finish it now?

finish_invitation.speaker: liam
finish_invitation.text: Mum hasn't seen the frame yet. I want the paper on when I show her.

finish_invitation.speaker: serene
finish_invitation.text: Then I shall let you get back to it.

finish_invitation.speaker: liam
finish_invitation.text: Will you still be here later?

finish_invitation.speaker: serene
finish_invitation.text: For a while. If you've more to ask, you know where to find me.

finish_invitation.speaker: liam
finish_invitation.text: I want to show you the stairs when they're done.

finish_invitation.speaker: serene
finish_invitation.text: You're welcome. Enjoy the rest of your afternoon.

finish_invitation.speaker: tomas
finish_invitation.text: Come on, then. Your father will be wondering how we got on.

finish_invitation.speaker: liam
finish_invitation.text: I'll tell him. I remember what she said.

finish_invitation.speaker: caelan
finish_invitation.text: All right. We'll walk back together.

home_return.speaker: liam_father
home_return.text: Back again. Was Serene able to give you some time?

home_return.speaker: caelan
home_return.text: She was. Thank you for keeping everything here.

home_return.speaker: liam_father
home_return.text: It's just where you left it.

home_return.speaker: liam_father
home_return.text: No. Your drawing's still beside it, too.

home_return.speaker: tomas
home_return.text: The one with the bigger steps?

home_return.speaker: liam
home_return.text: Yes. There's room for the window on that one.

home_return.speaker: liam_father
home_return.text: Then make yourselves comfortable. Shall we clear a little space for the work?

home_return.speaker: caelan
home_return.text: We can keep the practice pieces together at this end.

home_return.speaker: liam
home_return.text: Don't throw the first one away.

home_return.speaker: liam_father
home_return.text: You can keep all of them. We only need room for the piece you're using.

home_return.speaker: liam
home_return.text: I know. I haven't forgotten how big it is.

home_return.speaker: caelan
home_return.text: Let's look at the drawing again.

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: Elira carries one for her husband.

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: What about someone who hasn't got anybody there?

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: I don't know anyone like that. But there might be.

purpose.speaker: caelan
purpose.text: Were you thinking of carrying yours for them?

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: Even if I don't know their name?

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: (after a moment) I think I would.

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: It can still be a tower?

purpose.speaker: liam
purpose.text: Good. I want to keep the window.

final_panel.speaker: tomas
final_panel.text: These are the steps you tried before.

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: Those ones fit. The little ones went too far round.

final_panel.speaker: caelan
final_panel.text: Would you like me to hold this corner?

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: Yes. Don't move it yet.

final_panel.speaker: caelan
final_panel.text: Tell me when.

final_panel.speaker: liam_father
final_panel.text: Which of these sheets is the final piece?

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: This one. I'm keeping that one to look at.

final_panel.speaker: liam_father
final_panel.text: Then keep the two apart while you work. I'll help with the fastening afterward.

final_panel.speaker: tomas
final_panel.text: Where do you want the first step?

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: Here. Then it turns before the window.

final_panel.speaker: tomas
final_panel.text: You could mark the turn first.

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: I want to start at the bottom.

final_panel.speaker: tomas
final_panel.text: All right. I'll hold this side.

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: Not on the line.

final_panel.speaker: tomas
final_panel.text: Here?

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: Yes. That's better.

final_panel.speaker: caelan
final_panel.text: Is my corner still where you want it?

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: It is. Wait until I've checked the top.

final_panel.speaker: liam_father
final_panel.text: Take your time. The frame isn't going anywhere.

final_panel.speaker: liam
final_panel.text: All right. I know where I want it now.

dry_fit.speaker: liam_father
dry_fit.text: Before we fasten it, we'll try the paper around the frame.

dry_fit.speaker: liam_father
dry_fit.text: Yes. You show me which side you want at the front.

dry_fit.speaker: liam
dry_fit.text: This one. That's where the stairs come round.

dry_fit.speaker: caelan
dry_fit.text: Would you like me to steady the frame?

dry_fit.speaker: tomas
dry_fit.text: I can keep the loose edge from curling.

dry_fit.speaker: liam_father
dry_fit.text: Good. Liam, hold the paper lightly while we line it up.

dry_fit.speaker: liam_father
dry_fit.text: The point stays. We keep the opening at the top clear, just as Mira showed you.

dry_fit.speaker: liam_father
dry_fit.text: Then let's fit it and see where the edges meet.

dry_fit.speaker: liam
dry_fit.text: Don't fasten it until I've looked at the window.

fasten_covering.speaker: tomas
fasten_covering.text: And the turn in the stairs.

fasten_covering.speaker: liam_father
fasten_covering.text: The edges meet here. Are you happy with where they are?

fasten_covering.speaker: liam
fasten_covering.text: Can this one go a little further?

fasten_covering.speaker: liam_father
fasten_covering.text: A little. Keep the bottom level.

fasten_covering.speaker: caelan
fasten_covering.text: Show me where you'd like it held.

fasten_covering.speaker: liam
fasten_covering.text: Here. Until Dad fastens that part.

fasten_covering.speaker: liam_father
fasten_covering.text: I'll do the small fastening. You can hold the edge for me.

fasten_covering.speaker: liam_father
fasten_covering.text: We'll go around it a little at a time. No need to pull it all tight at once.

fasten_covering.speaker: liam
fasten_covering.text: I don't want the window bent.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam
finished_lantern.text: It's got all the sides on.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam_father
finished_lantern.text: It has. Let me check the joins and the handle before you pick it up.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam
finished_lantern.text: (looking at it) No. I like the window.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam_father
finished_lantern.text: The covering is secure. The opening's clear, and Mira's handle is holding well.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam_father
finished_lantern.text: Gently. Give yourself room, like you did with the frame.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam
finished_lantern.text: Mum will see it straight away, won't she?

finished_lantern.speaker: caelan
finished_lantern.text: She saw the drawing. You can show her how you made it fit.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam
finished_lantern.text: I want to tell her about the knot, too.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam_father
finished_lantern.text: You can tell her all of it. She's still at the school.

finished_lantern.speaker: caelan
finished_lantern.text: We know. We're coming with you.

finished_lantern.speaker: liam_father
finished_lantern.text: Ready? Lift it carefully and see how it feels.

school_welcome.speaker: liam
school_welcome.text: Yes. It's got the window now.

school_welcome.speaker: liam
school_welcome.text: I said it was going to be.

school_welcome.speaker: liam_mother
school_welcome.text: Just a moment, love. Tessa, leave that piece flat while it dries. Thank you.

school_welcome.speaker: liam_mother
school_welcome.text: Now, let me see. You've been busy.

school_welcome.speaker: liam
school_welcome.text: Mira helped with the frame. Then we finished it at home.

school_welcome.speaker: caelan
school_welcome.text: His father helped us with the covering.

school_welcome.speaker: liam_mother
school_welcome.text: Thank you for bringing him back. Is he going to let me have a proper look?

school_welcome.speaker: liam_mother
school_welcome.text: Of course you are. Come where I can see the front.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Show me the stairs.

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: I had to use bigger ones. Otherwise there wasn't room for the window.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: I see. They go around this side?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Yes. That one's a bit bent.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: May I look closer?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Gently.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Of course. And this is the corner you tied?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Mira checked it afterward.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Then you've had good company while you made it.

show_mother.speaker: tomas
show_mother.text: He did quite a lot himself.

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Caelan held the paper where I wanted it.

show_mother.speaker: caelan
show_mother.text: He told us where.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: (smiling) I'm glad you worked it out together.

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Do you like the point?

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: I do. It looks like the tower you showed me.

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: We changed the roof a bit. There has to be room for the heat.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Then I'm glad you listened to Mira.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: And who will you carry it for?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Someone who hasn't got one.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Someone without anybody there to carry a light for them?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: Yes. Is that all right?

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Yes, love. We'll make room for it beside ours.

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: I'll keep hold of it.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: Will you walk with me tomorrow?

show_mother.speaker: liam
show_mother.text: I want to carry it myself.

show_mother.speaker: liam_mother
show_mother.text: You can.

homeward.speaker: liam_mother
homeward.text: I've still got some things to put away here.

homeward.speaker: liam
homeward.text: Can I leave it with you?

homeward.speaker: liam_mother
homeward.text: There's rather a lot of paper about. I'd like yours kept safely at home until tomorrow.

homeward.speaker: liam
homeward.text: Dad said he would look after it.

homeward.speaker: caelan
homeward.text: We can walk him back and help him put it away.

homeward.speaker: liam_mother
homeward.text: Thank you. I'll be home when we're finished here.

homeward.speaker: tomas
homeward.text: We won't keep him out this time.

homeward.speaker: liam_mother
homeward.text: You have. And I'm glad you came.

homeward.speaker: liam
homeward.text: Will you remember which side has the window?

homeward.speaker: liam_mother
homeward.text: I think I'll remember. You can show me again tomorrow.

put_away.speaker: liam_father
put_away.text: Did she get to see it?

put_away.speaker: tomas
put_away.text: He showed her how the stairs fit, too.

put_away.speaker: liam_father
put_away.text: Good. Now let's find it a safe place for the night.

put_away.speaker: liam_father
put_away.text: Yes. I'll keep this space clear until tomorrow.

put_away.speaker: caelan
put_away.text: The drawing and practice pieces can stay together at the other side.

put_away.speaker: liam_father
put_away.text: It's well back from the edge. I'll mind it.

put_away.speaker: liam
put_away.text: All right. Which way should the window face?

put_away.speaker: liam_father
put_away.text: Where you can see it when you come in.

put_away.speaker: liam
put_away.text: This way, then. I'll set it down.

farewell.speaker: liam
farewell.text: There. You can see the window.

farewell.speaker: caelan
farewell.text: You can look at it again before you leave tomorrow.

farewell.speaker: liam
farewell.text: I will. I want to see Elira's as well.

farewell.speaker: tomas
farewell.text: She said to come and find her.

farewell.speaker: liam
farewell.text: And Serene hasn't seen this one yet.

farewell.speaker: caelan
farewell.text: You'll have time to show them.

farewell.speaker: liam_father
farewell.text: Thank you for giving him the afternoon, both of you.

farewell.speaker: liam
farewell.text: Thank you for helping with the paper.

farewell.speaker: liam_father
farewell.text: Go and get on with your preparations. We'll see you there.

finish_liam_waiting.speaker: liam
finish_liam_waiting.text: I want Mum to see the window when it's finished.

finish_tomas_waiting.speaker: tomas
finish_tomas_waiting.text: We've got time. We're staying together.

father_before_finish.speaker: liam_father
father_before_finish.text: The frame and papers are just where you left them. Make yourselves comfortable.

father_during_finish.speaker: liam_father
father_during_finish.text: Keep the practice piece beside you. You can look back at it while you work.

father_finished_home.speaker: liam_father
father_finished_home.text: His mother will be glad to see it. Bring it home afterward and we'll keep it safe.

father_done.speaker: liam_father
father_done.text: Thank you for the afternoon. The lantern's safe here until tomorrow.

mother_before_show.speaker: liam_mother
mother_before_show.text: Come and find me when you're ready to show me your lantern, love.

mother_after_show.speaker: liam_mother
mother_after_show.text: I'm glad you brought it. Take it home carefully; I'll be back when we've finished here.

mother_done.speaker: liam_mother
mother_done.text: Thank you for helping Liam today. He's looking forward to carrying his own tomorrow.

serene_finish_waiting.speaker: serene
serene_finish_waiting.text: I'll be here with my papers for a while. Enjoy your afternoon together.

serene_done.speaker: serene
serene_done.text: We'll see one another at the festival. I'm looking forward to the company.

mira_done.speaker: mira
mira_done.text: I hope Liam's pleased with his tower. He was quite sure what he wanted.

elira_done.speaker: elira
elira_done.text: I'll bring my lantern tomorrow. Come and find me when you're there.

liam_finished.speaker: liam
liam_finished.text: Can you see the window from that side?

liam_done.speaker: liam
liam_done.text: Mum said I can carry it myself tomorrow.

tomas_done.speaker: tomas
tomas_done.text: I want to see that window with the light behind it tomorrow.
